verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a natural-language interface built into Outlook is a single community mention of 'Copilot in Outlook'. That user found it slower than copy-pasting, which questions its usefulness but does not show it fails to work. The Graph API docs are developer building blocks, and the user's own LLM/MCP search setup is an external workaround, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Copilot or natural-language command capabilities in Outlook, evidence of which actions can be performed via natural language (drafting, searching, triaging, scheduling), hands-on corroboration that commands operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
